top_concerns: No ablations or comparisons against other coding agents or a single-LLM baseline, so component contributions are unsupported
Human-in-the-loop intervention confounds headline results; which results are autonomous is unclear
Baseline tuning and selection unspecified (possible test-set selection), no seeds or variance, and Helmsman wins only about half the tasks despite 'often superior' claim
Q16 gain (51.04 vs 28.56) likely comes from replay, which exemplar-free baselines do not use; generated code not inspected
Small author-built benchmark with no cost, success-rate or robustness metrics; deployment and robustness claims untested
